bullets.text: Windows Update Experience Enhanced - **Microsoft** improves user control over updates for a smoother PC experience.
New Experimental Channels Launched - **Microsoft** transitions users to new Experimental and Beta channels for better feedback integration.
AI Apps Made Easy - **Microsoft** offers a free course on building AI agents with **LangChain.js** for JavaScript developers.
Secure Passkey Sync Introduced - **Microsoft Password Manager** now syncs passkeys across devices for enhanced security.
Windows 365 Link Celebrates Year - **Microsoft**'s Windows 365 Link simplifies management and security for cloud PCs.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense - **Microsoft** leverages AI to enhance vulnerability discovery and threat mitigation strategies.
Azure Accelerate for Databases Launched - **Microsoft** helps organizations modernize databases for AI readiness with new offerings.
Frontier Transformation with Partners - **Microsoft** partners drive AI adoption, focusing on security and governance in production.
